'''Romello Da'Quan White''' (born May 9, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Köping Stars]] of the [[Basketligan]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State Sun Devils]] and the [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss Rebels]].

==High school career==
White attended [[Wheeler High School (Georgia)|Wheeler High School]]. He developed a relationship with former NBA player [[Jerry Stackhouse]] in high school, and Stackhouse became his mentor. White originally signed with [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]], but reconsidered after coach [[Brian Gregory]] was fired. He committed to [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]] because he had a relationship with former assistant coach Anthony Coleman.<ref name="gardner" />

==College career==
White redshirted his true freshman season to improve his academics. He became a starter as a redshirt freshman and averaged 10.5 points and 7.1 rebounds per game. White averaged 8.7 points and 5.2 rebounds per game as a sophomore. He worked on his conditioning and nutrition in the offseason and lost 10 pounds.<ref name="gardner">{{cite news |last1=Gardner |first1=Michelle |title=Romello White looks to be dominant force in paint for ASU basketball |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/asu/2019/11/02/romello-white-looks-dominant-force-paint-asu-basketball/2504952001/ |access-date=July 17, 2021 |work=[[The Arizona Republic]] |date=November 2, 2019}}</ref> As a junior, White averaged 10.2 points and 8.8 rebounds per game, and posted eight double-doubles.

Following the season, he transferred to [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gardner |first1=Michelle |title=Former ASU basketball standout Romello White transfers to Mississippi |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/asu/2020/05/15/former-asu-basketball-standout-romello-white-transfers-mississippi/5199715002/ |access-date=July 17, 2021 |work=[[The Arizona Republic]] |date=May 15, 2020}}</ref> On February 6, 2021, he scored a career-high 30 points and had 10 rebounds and four blocks in an 86–84 win against [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Shuler scores with 0.2 left in OT, gets Ole Miss past Auburn |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401258787 |access-date=July 17, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 6, 2021}}</ref> During his redshirt senior season, White averaged 11.4 points and 6 rebounds per game, led the team with 36 blocks, and set the Ole Miss single-season record with a 64.9 percent shooting percentage.<ref>{{cite web |title=Romello White Sets Single-Season School Record |url=https://olemisssports.com/news/2021/3/22/mens-basketball-romello-white-sets-single-season-school-record.aspx |website=[[Ole Miss Rebels]] |access-date=July 17, 2021 |date=March 22, 2021}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On July 11, 2021, White signed his first professional contract with [[Hapoel Eilat B.C.|Hapoel Eilat]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Romello White joins Hapoel Eilat |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/romello-white-joins-hapoel-eilat/ |website=Sportando |access-date=July 17, 2021 |date=July 11, 2021}}</ref> He averaged 10.7 points and 4.0 rebounds per game, but left the team in December 2021.

On March 6, 2022, White signed with [[Keravnos B.C.|Keravnos Strovolou]] of the [[Cyprus Basketball Division A]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Katsaros |first1=Antonis |title=Keravnos sign Romello White, ex H.Eilat |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Israel/news/734115/Keravnos-sign-Romello-White,-ex-H.Eilat |website=Eurobasket |access-date=March 6, 2022 |date=March 6, 2022}}</ref>

White spent the 2022–2023 season with Israeli club [[Ironi Nahariya]].

On July 31, 2023, White signed with Greek club [[ASK Karditsas B.C.|Karditsa]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ο Ρομέλο Ουάιτ δεύτερος ξένος για την Καρδίτσα |url=http://www.esake.gr/el/view/o-romello-white-deuteros-xenos-tis-karditsas |access-date=2025-08-23 |website=- Ε.Σ.Α.Κ.Ε.}}</ref> After suffering a torn patella in the end of the season, White had his rehabilitation period with the team<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sportal.gr |date=2024-08-18 |title=Μεγάλη κίνηση της Καρδίτσας: Κρατάει τον Ρομέλο Ουάιτ που θα κάνει το πρόγραμμα αποκατάστασης με την ομάδα |url=https://www.sportal.gr/basket/article/karditsa-krataei-ton-romelo-oyait-kai-ton-voithaei-me-tin-apokatastasi-2024081813485872592 |access-date=2025-08-23 |website=Sportal.gr |language=el}}</ref> and re-signed with Karditsa for the 2025-26 season. On November 30, 2025, White amicably parted ways with the Greek club.
